title: Add guardrails and responsive cards for Admin identity provider actions
description:
Problem: the continued `/admin` OAuth review showed provider rows with enabled/configured state, linked-account counts, setup links, and Enable/Disable actions in a table that becomes long on narrow screens. The actions are operationally significant, but the UI does not clearly distinguish routine status scanning from provider-changing actions or explain the effects before activation/deactivation.

Desired outcome: Admin identity provider management should make provider status easy to scan and require intentional, well-explained action for enable/disable changes.

Scope:
- In scope: OAuth/provider responsive row/card layout, enable/disable confirmation or warning copy, disabled/precondition explanations, setup-link affordances, account-count visibility, and accessible labels/tooltips.
- Out of scope: changing provider configuration storage, OAuth callback behavior, or bootstrap auth rules.

Acceptance criteria:
- Provider state, configured status, and linked-account count remain clear at narrow and desktop widths.
- Enable/disable controls explain consequences and require an intentional confirmation for risky state changes.
- Setup links are discoverable without overwhelming the row/card.
- Browser checks cover at least one disabled provider and one enabled provider state without mutating live credentials in destructive ways.

Validation:
- Capture `/admin` OAuth before/after at narrow and desktop widths.
- Add or run focused browser checks for provider action affordances and accessible names, using fixture/safe test state where available.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from 2026-05-25 continued live review: Admin OAuth provider management exposed important enable/disable actions in a dense table without a clear action-safety hierarchy on narrow width.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented Admin OAuth provider cards with clear enabled/disabled status, configured state, linked-account count, setup links, updated timestamp, action impact copy, disabled precondition explanations, and accessible enable/disable button labels. Provider toggles now require confirmation before changing state; built-in system providers and unconfigured providers cannot be toggled from the card action. Validation: dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo passed; route-smoke passed 6/6 against http://127.0.0.1:5099. Authenticated OAuth browser mutation checks remain blocked by the missing Playwright auth fixture, so validation avoided live credential mutation.
